'''Ewok''' is a retro constructed format: the [[Premiere - Death Star II]] card pool with a ban list of about a hundred cards. The Players Committee forum names it '''Premiere - Death Star II (Ewok)''', or PDS2E for short.<ref name="t86581" /> [[Bill Bisco]] created it for the 2026 Retro Ewok Championship and announced it on the forum on 20 March 2026, calling the event "a first of its kind tournament to explore a new Retro 'Ewok' Format".<ref name="t86581" />

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' [[Bill Bisco]], Players Committee forum (2026)
* '''Card pool:''' Premiere through Death Star II, with a ban list
* '''In use:''' 2026 &ndash;
* '''Also called:''' Premiere - Death Star II (Ewok), PDS2E<ref name="t86581" />
* '''GEMP:''' ''Ewok'' (<code>ewok</code>) on play.swccg.com; none on the Players Committee GEMP

== Card pool ==
On [[GEMP]] it is named '''Ewok''' (code <code>ewok</code>). Its card pool is the same as [[Premiere - Death Star II]], Decipher set ids 1&ndash;9 and premium ids 101&ndash;111, with a ban list of 101 card printings. The definition links to the forum announcement.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" /> The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" />

=== Goals ===
The announcement lists these goals for the format:<ref name="t86581" />
# Create a new Retro Format that adds twists to an existing popular Retro Format.
# Ban cards and strategies that are too popular and/or too powerful.
# Get people playing decks and using strategies that have not been seen in PDS2 tournaments.
# Get people to play "Bad" Objectives.
# Tone back Power Creep.
# De-escalate the Battle Destiny and Immunity to Attrition Arms Race.
# Reduce must have starting effects and must have defenses in decks.

=== Ban list ===
The two sources give different ban lists. The forum list, as preserved on 21 October 2026, has five cards that are not on the GEMP list at commit ec48dc19. They are ''Bossk In Hound's Tooth'', ''Dengar In Punishing One'', ''Imperial Command'' and ''Ralltiir Operations'' (Dark Side) and ''Honor Of The Jedi'' (Light Side). Every card on the GEMP list is also on the forum list.<ref name="t86581" /><ref name="gemp" /> Both versions are given below.

The forum thread explains each ban and keeps a log of changes to the list, dated from 21 March to July 2026. For example, ''Asteroid Sanctuary'' was banned on 20 April 2026 after feedback that it would be abused in the format, and a July 2026 update added ''Honor Of The Jedi''.<ref name="t86581" />

== History ==
When Bisco announced the format it was not yet coded on GEMP; the announcement says a GitHub pull request had the code.<ref name="t86581" /> play.swccg.com now has it as ''Ewok''; the Players Committee format list does not.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="pc-gemp" />

=== 2026 Retro Ewok Championship ===
The announcement describes match play: each match is two games, one on each side of the Force, and the player with the higher net life force across both games advances, with fewer cards in the Lost Piles as the tiebreaker. Games use 60-minute timers per player. Entry was free, and the posted prizes were cash and playmats. Bisco funded the event himself.<ref name="t86581" /> No source on this wiki gives its dates or results yet.
